pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft-edged pixel gradients. Individual patches show moderate variation in spatial area across the flank and lower neck regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Inter-patch network of light pelage characterized by high pixel thickness. Topological graph shows frequent tri-directional and tetra-directional junction nodes with high continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a distinct low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the jagged edge is consistent along the visible dorsal line of the neck.
